% A float and a \pagebreak in one line: the float's two forced breaks and
% the \pagebreak's reach the page in order, so the float is placed and
% none is lost (pdflatex: no error).
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Text \begin{figure}[htbp]\centering\rule{1cm}{100pt}\caption{A float}\end{figure}
more text.\pagebreak
Text after.
\gdef\SatexReachedEnd{}
\end{document}
